card.text: TOI-5624 d was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-5624 d"
sources.quote: TOI-5624 d is the third and largest discovered exoplanet orbiting the star TOI-5624, with a size approximately three and a half times the diameter of Earth.

introduction.text: It is one of 5 planets known around TOI-5624. Its orbit and size follow Bonfanti et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-5624 d"
sources.quote: The planet was confirmed in late April 2026 using the transit method.
